selection: 80 official dev-train and 40 official dev-test 10-second windows; 62.5% laughter target where available; natural overlap ranked first; at most two windows per source recording; any window containing Music class 8 excluded
source_identity_mapping: simultaneous source-specific laughter frames are unioned because Attune events do not carry source identity
language: unverified; STARSS23 metadata has no language field
privacy_consent: Natural participant recordings; collection included consent and published face-blurring procedures, but this operational review is not independent consent verification. Use only for bounded research.
